ns2:course.label: Advanced Geog Info Systems
ns2:course.description: Introduces the concepts of digital cartographic data, spatial analysis methods, and process modeling. Prerequisite: GEOG 280, GEOG 371, GEOG 379; or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: GEOG 280, GEOG 371, GEOG 379; or equivalent.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture.
